description: This file defines an interface for a service handling creation, update, and deletion of product mixes in the loan product module of Apache Fineract.

classes.name: ProductMixWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for product mix write operations such as create, update, and delete in the loan product module.

methods.name: createProductMix
methods.description: Creates a new product mix for a given product ID using data from the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateProductMix
methods.description: Updates an existing product mix associated with the given product ID based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteProductMix
methods.description: Deletes the product mix associated with the given product ID.
